title: The Amazing World of Gumball - Filth, Filth, All Around (Teri's J-Pop Music Video)
description: Song from the Cartoon Network series The Amazing World of Gumball, from season 5 episode 31, "The Singing" (187th episode overall, first aired in the US on 2017-09-01). Teri, a paper-cutout character, sings "Filth, Filth, All Around" during a hallucination styled after Kyary Pamyu Pamyu's PONPONPON music video. The lyrics are about germs and cleanliness, and in the episode a doctor calls it "the worst case of J-pop I've ever seen". The linked YouTube video is a 41-second clip of the scene uploaded by fabian cruzzz on 2017-08-26.
